items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Jesse Price, he quit, and we come, we got this group together, and we went right on down to San Diego.

ctx.x: And, see, like I tell you, I was all, everywhere I went, I was always working. Oh, shit. Now, like the one time in California, when I quit Mike Shan and Cobb, I worked a little in my cousin owned a cleaning shop at another property, I worked a little in there. And then, Jesse Price, he quit, and we come, we got this group together, and we went right on down to San Diego. Yeah. We worked, oh, we recorded out there, too.
